review_method: Actual full six-row PNG displayed using view_image; not inferred from generating the file
observations: Early and middle dynamic objects have low confidence; confidence on black background is not observed foreground geometry.
Anchor86 first-partner dynamic coverage is only1.2 percent and the raw reprojection is grossly inconsistent.
Late images have stronger predicted confidence, but scaled maps change drastically between static and camera estimates.
Projection panels show errors over all confident pixels, including unobserved black background; table statistics use eroded dynamic foreground.
These pointmap panels are diagnostics, not PIDG novel-view renderings or evidence of complete moving objects.
